content.description: Should be a ref to an entity type mixing Content containing the data to import.

url.description: Url of the file to import from file system

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of fields to be excluded during import

createOnly.description:
If true then it will be assumed that all obs don't previously exist and we will create them with no attempt to fetch them to see if they exist.
This will have better performance if it is known beforehand that they don't exist.

directPath.description:
If true then hints to c3 data engine to bypass application logic and write data directly to datastore.

This is only supported for the Cassandra datastore currently.

updateMode.description:
If updateMode is set to "merge" then values in the existing record that are not provided by import content
will be ignored. Otherwise they will be overwritten by the new values, including null values.

retrySingleObjOnFailure.description: If true then on failure will retry single Obj at a time.

numErrorsToAbort.description: Number of errors after which import will be aborted.

commitSize.description: How many records to commit at a time.

ignoreFKeyFields.description: Ignores columns that refer to fkey fields - i.e. fields that are not updatable in the context of this type.

progressCallbackPeriod.description: Wait time in seconds between progress report callbacks. Only meaningful if progressCallback is specified.

progressCallback.description: Should be a ref to an entity type mixing {@link ImportProgress}

disableAsyncProcessing.description: Disables firing of async events during data import.

title: Specification of the options/parameters for the {@link Importable.importData} function.
